_comment: GAV Ontology Bridge  -  Asali/Nakali Heterogeneous Database Integration System.
_description: Global-as-View (GAV) schema mapping that defines the global canonical schema
and maps it to local source schemas across 4 isolated heterogeneous databases.
The canonical integration key is 'item_code'  -  the same physical value stored
under different column names in each DB due to independent system design.
Regulatory context: India Ministry of Consumer Affairs (MCA) + CDSCO
(Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation, under Ministry of Health).
Real-world mandate: Schedule H2, Drugs Rules 1945 (G.S.R. 823(E), effective
August 1, 2023)  -  mandates QR/barcode with unique product ID on top 300 brands.

regulatory_context.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution (MCA)
regulatory_context.scope: Top 300 pharmaceutical brands + vaccines + antimicrobials + anti-cancer + narcotics

canonical_description: Unique serialized medicine identifier, equivalent to GS1 SGTIN in the real-world CDSCO track-and-trace system. Same physical value stored under different column names in each database due to isolated, independently-designed systems.
gav_pipeline: 1. identifier_normalizer.py   -  normalize raw code variants to canonical form
2. schema_mapping.json        -  GAV ontology: map canonical key to each source alias
3. resolver.py                -  query each source via its local column name (wrapper layer)
6. trust_engine.py            -  Tier-2: soft probabilistic compliance scoring

db1_purchase.column_alias_note: Same as canonical item_code  -  column named 'scan_code' by POS system designers
db1_purchase.lookup_query: SELECT pe.*, v.vendor_name, v.vendor_type, v.location_county, v.active as vendor_active, v.license_no as vendor_license FROM purchase_events pe LEFT JOIN vendors v ON pe.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE pe.scan_code = ? ORDER BY pe.scan_timestamp DESC

db2_distributor.column_alias_note: Same as canonical item_code  -  column named 'batch_serial' by distributor ERP developers
db2_distributor.lookup_query: SELECT db.*, d.company_name as dist_name, d.is_authorized, d.license_no as dist_license, d.license_expiry as dist_license_expiry FROM distribution_batches db LEFT JOIN distributors d ON db.distributor_id = d.distributor_id WHERE db.batch_serial = ? ORDER BY db.dispatch_date DESC

db3_manufacturer.column_alias_note: Same as canonical item_code  -  column named 'product_uid' by manufacturer's internal registry system
db3_manufacturer.lookup_query: SELECT p.*, m.company_name as mfg_name, m.gmp_certified, m.cdsco_license_no, m.license_expiry as mfg_license_expiry FROM products p JOIN manufacturers m ON p.manufacturer_id = m.manufacturer_id WHERE p.product_uid = ?

db4_ministry.column_alias_note: Same as canonical item_code  -  column named 'complaint_item_ref' by Ministry's INGRAM grievance portal schema
db4_ministry.lookup_query: SELECT * FROM complaints WHERE complaint_item_ref = ? ORDER BY complaint_date DESC

gav_column_alias_map._comment: The core heterogeneity demonstration: same canonical item_code stored under 4 different column names

trust_score_weights._comment: Tier-2 soft compliance deductions. Tier-1 hard veto forces score=0 regardless of these.

_rationale.cold_chain_broken: Temperature-sensitive APIs (insulin, vaccines) degrade irreversibly  -  high safety risk
_rationale.distributor_unauthorized: Unauthorized distribution is a criminal offense under Drugs Act 1940, s.18B
_rationale.vendor_custody_bypass: Chain-of-custody break is primary indicator of diverted/stolen stock
_rationale.price_below_mrp: Counterfeits sold below 40% MRP  -  genuine API cost makes this impossible legitimately
_rationale.open_complaints: Existing MCA complaints indicate known consumer harm
_rationale.supply_chain_gap: No distributor record = medicine materialized from nowhere
_rationale.distributor_unlicensed: Operating without valid drug license under Drugs Act 1940, s.18
_rationale.product_recalled: CDSCO/manufacturer recall = product safety concern confirmed
_rationale.product_expired: Selling expired medicine is illegal under Drugs Act 1940, s.18A
_rationale.lab_test_fail: NABL-accredited lab failure = confirmed quality issue
_rationale.multi_location_anomaly: Physical impossibility = 100% confirmation of cloned barcode

verdict_thresholds._comment: Adjusted from v1: ASALI threshold lowered to 80 (was 85) to correctly classify items with minor soft issues as SUSPICIOUS not NAKALI. Tier-1 veto always overrides to 0.

lifecycle_states.MINTED: Registered in DB3 Manufacturer Registry. Not yet dispatched.
lifecycle_states.DISPATCHED: In transit with licensed distributor (DB2, IN_TRANSIT).
lifecycle_states.DISPENSED: Sold to consumer (DB1 purchase event exists).
lifecycle_states.FLAGGED: Active MCA complaint or blacklist entry (DB4).
lifecycle_states.UNKNOWN: Not in manufacturer DB  -  cannot determine legitimate state.

hard_veto_gates._comment: These are Tier-1 gates. Any trigger -> score=0, verdict=NAKALI, auto-FIR draft.
hard_veto_gates.V1_PHANTOM_SERIAL: Item code not in CDSCO-registered Manufacturer DB (DB3)
hard_veto_gates.V2_MINISTRY_BLACKLIST: Item or batch on active MCA/CDSCO blacklist (DB4)
hard_veto_gates.V4_REPLAY_SCAN: Serial already DISPENSED  -  barcode clone/replay attack
hard_veto_gates.V5_CUSTODY_BYPASS: Sold by vendor not in authorized dispatch route (DB1 x DB2)
